record.summary: The orchestrator command group follows the API to v2: a projects subgroup (list, add, arm, disarm, requalify, remove), a --project flag scoping the existing verbs to a named project, a composite status that renders the daemon state plus one row per project, and an offline journal verify that resolves a project's state root through the daemon home's registry chain. Client-not-engine, exit codes, and the X-Control-Source discipline from 023 carry over unchanged.
record.title: CLI v2: the projects group and project-scoped verbs
